speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties. To help narrow down the cause, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been developing and if you have noticed any changes in your memory or behavior?

text: Do you have any history of head trauma or meningitis, and have you noticed any changes in your mood or personality? I also need to know if you have experienced any headaches or vision changes.
